title: A new wallpaper for your Mac

cta.appStoreDescription: Install and update through the Mac App Store. This edition includes most Codelume features.
cta.websiteDescription: Download the installer directly to also set native macOS wallpapers and lock screen wallpapers.
cta.existingAccount: If you already have an account, sign in to it in the website version first. Then open My Profile → Account Settings → Sign-in Email to add your email. Your website-version Pro access stays with that account.
cta.websiteReason: Both features need access to system wallpaper components beyond what the App Store edition’s sandbox allows. Native wallpapers in the website edition are managed by macOS for smoother transitions. Choose the edition that suits your needs.

pro.title: Website Edition Pro
pro.features: Unlock multiple displays, web and scene wallpapers, and native macOS wallpapers and screensavers.
pro.purchase: Buy in the website edition of Codelume. Checkout shows the final amount.

systemRequirements.title: System requirements
systemRequirements.description: The website version requires macOS 14.6 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Native system wallpapers and screensaver wallpapers require macOS 26 or later.

video.unsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.

subtitle: Set native Mac wallpapers and choose from more wallpaper types in Codelume.
editionNote: Standard is free to use. Pro offers more features.
wallpaperSubmissionNote: Selected community wallpapers may be featured on our homepage.
